mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates tighter monetary policy, increasing discount rates for equity valuation models and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decrease in the unemployment rate signals a tightening monetary policy in a tight labor market, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening residential investment, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines in late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC for the HOUST decline signal in late-cycle expansions is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects a contraction in manufacturing and industrial sectors, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales value above $710 billion (RSAFS > 710000) indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 710000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change above 3.5%) signals prolonged monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) reflects a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
